## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f7fa38653f2b5e451d4870369afd8dab5884ef18`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

PR #35309 (draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`), `Fixes #34967`, `Fixes #35117`, `Part of #34546`. Read: the three cards with every comment, the dev report 6999096112, ruling record 6513306068, the net diff against merge-base `c809deb67b`, and the cited code at the head. All paths below are at the head; `data-hooks.md:N` is the head file.

Why `Security-touching: yes`: three changed hunks shorten text that teaches permission and sharing behaviour. Pattern 4 (never gate a mask exemption on a session claim; a per-set exemption belongs in field-level permissions), the copy-paste example (a cross-object write needs the acting user's edit right on the target), and "Reading the current organization" (the value RLS and sharing predicates read). The rule taught is unchanged in each case and keeps its other home. No platform protection bypass was found.

### ① Derived judgments

No accept-set or published-surface change: served skill text, two eval cases, one ratchet row. Each claim the diff makes, judged:

1. `api.transaction` row, own transaction ("commit on return, rollback on throw"): right. The sandbox sugar begins, commits on return, rolls back and re-throws on a throw (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1224-1234`, leaves `:806-856`); the trio opens on the default driver (`packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts:328-362`) and closes there (`:366-392`).
2. Row, "one datasource": right but under-specified, see S1. The transaction always opens on the DEFAULT driver (`engine-scoped-context.ts:228`, `:315-326`; ADR-0119 D1: "covers only the default driver"); `EngineTransactionOptions` has no datasource selector (`packages/spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts:144-163`).
3. Row, the refusal: right. `enforceTransactionOrigin` runs at the top of insert, update and delete, before hooks and validation (`packages/objectql/src/engine-execute-transactions.ts:253`, `:293-320`); the code is `ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE` (`packages/objectql/src/transaction-errors.ts:124`, `:149-173`); the trio handle is judged since PR #35102 (`engine-scoped-context.ts:350-360`); `400` with that code is pinned at the action door (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-body-transaction-audit-split.dogfood.test.ts:163-170`).
4. Row, the join: right for every unit the host opens. The callback face joins the ambient unit and neither commits nor rolls back (`engine-scoped-context.ts:215-224`); the trio joins with `owned: false` (`:335-342`) and its commit and rollback abstain (`:367`, `:382`); the runner abstains too and the sugar re-throws (`quickjs-runner.ts:827-856`). The write door opens that unit for an aborting `after*` hook or a metadata `before*` hook, on the default datasource only (`packages/objectql/src/engine-hooks-and-functions.ts:537-553`). Pinned on a real engine and real QuickJS: `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/transaction-ambient-join.integration.test.ts:152`, `:169`, `:188`, `:209`, `:242`. Two bounds are not stated, see N2.
5. `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx:373-374` ("A nested `transaction()` joins the outer unit, so its return is no commit") holds against the three faces above and `packages/objectql/src/engine-transactions-section.ts:72-78`. It says nothing about a throw; the "throw no rollback" half of the row is from code, not from those two lines, and the code supports it. The same two bounds apply to the docs sentence (N2).
6. `ctx.text` row and the "Declared texts" prose: right, sentence by sentence.
   - No capability: `quickjs-runner.ts:1067-1104` installs it with no capability check.
   - A `js` body or a `handler`, never an `expression` body: `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts:343-357`; served on both doors (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts:557`, `:390-399`).
   - Organization's language, Localization setting else `i18n.defaultLocale`, never the saver's: `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.ts:147`, `:189`; `packages/core/src/organization-locale.ts:84-116`, `:185-198`.
   - Translated first, then filled; a missing translation writes the declared `message`: `hook-text.ts:148-162`.
   - An unreadable setting rejects: `organization-locale.ts:143-157` (only an unregistered setting reads as unset); pinned at `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.integration.test.ts:213-229`.
   - Only declared keys, at save when literal, else at run: `hook.zod.ts:358-365`, `hook-text.ts:143-146`. The `500` matches `hooks.mdx:500-501` and the fault rule in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts:27-32`; the status itself was not traced further.
   - "Holes as in `refusals`": same rules (`hook.zod.ts:382-399`), and `data-hooks.md:852-853` states them.
7. The example in that block: WRONG on its second statement, see M1.
8. Seven cuts: each is a true restatement and none removes the only statement of a rule. Byte deltas per hunk from the diff: 137, 137, 161, 85, 241, 223, 275 = 1259 removed.
   - Cut 1 ("Why so few?", per-row context detail): kept at `data-hooks.md:173-179` (`before*`), `:186-190` (`after*`), `:246` (`ctx.input` row).
   - Cut 2 ("Sandbox vs in-process"): kept in the table at `:211-216`; the new anchor names the heading at `:239`.
   - Cut 3 (organization sentence): kept at `:459-460` and `:490`.
   - Cut 4 (`body` example): the rule is at `:233-235`, the shape at `:220-228`, a worked `before*` body at `references/examples-objects.md:124`.
   - Cut 5 (`session.roles` comment): kept at `:250`, `:462-463`, and the callout at `:669-673`.
   - Cut 6 (partial patch comment): Gotcha 1 `:358-369` and the intro `:389-390`.
   - Cut 7 (edit right comment): Gotcha 2 `:371-385`.
   - Eval check, because the runner installs only the case's own bundle without `evals/` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/arms.ts:86-100`) and grades literal substrings (`grade.ts:27-31`): all 187 `must_contain` tokens of the 48 graded cases in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json` (27 + 21; `triggers.json` carries no assertions) are present in the head bundle. No token left the bundle. Five lost one occurrence in this file and all remain: `afterUpdate` 16 to 15, `language: 'js'` 9 to 8, `ctx.previous.id` 7 to 6, `lookup` 5 to 4, `organization_id` 4 to 3. No case's prompt asks for a statement a cut removed.
9. Evals 28 and 29: the tokens are taught by the new text and by nothing else in the bundle on `main` (`ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`, `texts`, `ctx.text` had no hit outside `evals/`), the prompts do not leak them, ids are unique. Two soft spots in case 28's `expected_output`, see N1.
10. Ratchet: the numbers hold. Base 40004 bytes (10001 of 10011), head 40492 bytes, `ceil(40492 / 4) = 10123`; adds 144 + 390 + 1213 = 1747, cuts 1259, net 488. Ruling B's four conditions are met: same-file restatement deletions are in the diff, the PR body quotes the 2026-10-27 words and record 6513306068, the row moves by the measured remainder (+112), and it is pinned at the measurement (headroom 0). Net growth of 122 tokens for three cards is within the 10402 principle. The row comment agrees with the diff.
11. Other skills: nothing contradicts the new text. `skills/objectstack-automation/**` says nothing on `texts` or `api.transaction` and routes hooks to objectstack-data (`SKILL.md:9`); `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` has no `texts` key on this head (S2); the other transaction statements in this file (`:62-63`, `:331`, `:797`, `:806`) agree with the row.

### ② Semver level

Right. `.changeset/34967-data-hooks-transaction-texts.md` is `@objectstack/skills` patch with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, both line-initial there and in the PR body. Text-only served skill text changes nothing an author can write, so the kind is `none` and `none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). No `!`, no arm, no BREAKING banner owed. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the dev report.
- Dev deviations (PR body footer, one gate run twice, commit trailer form): none touches the reviewed faces; no L2 action.
- Out-of-scope note 1 (the sandbox refuses a `ctx.api.transaction` nested in another in one body): confirmed, `quickjs-runner.ts:806-807` throws `nested ctx.api.transaction is not supported`. No test pins it, no doc or skill states it, and no open card covers it. It MERITS A CARD: the new row and `hooks.mdx:373-374` both say "joins" with no bound, so an author is now more likely to nest. One `review follow-ups of PR #35309` card, p3 (the failure is loud), carrying N2 and N3 with it.
- Out-of-scope note 2 (a delete's `ctx.input`): NO card. The two statements describe different doors and the file says which. The handler context is `input: { id, options }` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:236`); a body receives a snapshot of the payload keys only (`body-runner.ts:1481`, `:1553`), so a delete's is empty. The section header at `data-hooks.md:437-438` names the handler door, pattern 1 at `:583-600` is a body, and `:176`, `:190`, `:246` state the per-door rule.
- Card #34546 placement: the card names `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (or its reference file). The declaration half lands in the data skill's hooks reference, which is where hooks are taught. Accepted; the hand-close of #34546 should record it, since the automation skill itself gains nothing in either PR.
- Cross-PR, for the seat: open draft PR #34964 (same file) cuts the `after*` per-row bullet and names as its other home the "Why so few?" sentence that cut 1 of this PR removes. This PR's own homes for cut 1 are untouched by #34964, so this PR is safe in either order; #34964 loses its cited home once this lands and owes a re-read. If #34964 lands first, this PR's ratchet pin and its arithmetic comment go stale and need re-measuring.
- Check-runs on the head: every run is completed, and each is success or skipped except one. `PR-body guards` failed at 03:47:23Z (`check:closing-target-claim` and `check:partof-closing-keyword`: the body then carried a closing keyword on #34546). The same job re-ran on the same head at 04:20:03Z after the body edit and is success. No red stands.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`

M1 (must-fix) — the "Declared texts" example writes `undefined` into the task's link. `data-hooks.md:869-871` labels the fragment an `afterInsert` body and inserts `related_to_lead: ctx.input.id`. On an insert `ctx.input.id` is always `undefined`, on both doors:
  - the hook input of an insert is `{ data, options }` with no `id` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts:644`), and the id is minted later in the driver on a copy (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-crud.ts:329-334`);
  - the reserved name `id` never reads through to the payload (`packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts:742-751`), pinned at `packages/objectql/src/hook-input-envelope-precedence.test.ts:163-187`, a spread included;
  - a body's `ctx.input` is the payload snapshot (`body-runner.ts:1481`, `:1553`);
  - the governing docs say so: `hooks.mdx:216` ("or undefined on insert").
  The source example (`hooks.mdx:465-477`) is an `afterUpdate` handler, where `ctx.input.id` is the target row; the skill changed the event and the door and kept the read. The same file teaches the opposite at `:246`, `:248`, `:564` and pattern 2 `:628`, and eval 12 forbids this class (`account_id: ctx.input.id`). The fragment is unmarked, so `check:skill-examples` does not read it. Copied as written, which eval 29's prompt invites, every follow-up task is created with no lead. Fix: `ctx.result.id`. That is one byte more: 40493 bytes is 10124 tokens, over the 10123 pin, so trim a byte or re-measure the row.

S1 (should-fix) — "one transaction on one datasource" does not say which. It is the default datasource (① item 2). A callback whose writes are ALL on one non-default datasource is refused too, and a reader of the row, and of eval 28's "keep the objects one transaction writes on one datasource", concludes the opposite. `hooks.mdx:343-344` names the default datasource. Fix: "the default datasource" in the row and in the eval's expected answer.

S2 (should-fix) — the translation key is nowhere in the skills on this head. `data-hooks.md:881` points to objectstack-i18n for it, and that skill has no `texts` key until PR #35302 lands (`hooks.{hook}.texts.{key}.message`, read in that PR's diff at `14899df1c2`). The `refusals` block in the same file states its own key inline (`:854-855`). Close either way: land #35302 first and have the delta record confirm the target, or state the key in one clause here.

N1 (nit) — eval 28's `expected_output`, which is neither sent nor graded (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts:91-93`). (a) "or write the ledger outside it": inside the save's unit a plain `ctx.api` write to another datasource is refused the same way (`engine-execute-transactions.ts:309-319` reads the ambient scope; `hooks.mdx:338-340`); what works is a write outside the unit, such as an `async: true` hook (`hooks.mdx:382-383`). (b) The refused object is named `ledger_entry`, while the one class the engine carves out of this refusal is the append-only ledger (`lifecycle.class` `audit`, `telemetry`, `event`; `engine-execute-transactions.ts:318`, `transaction-errors.ts:144-147`). A neutral object name avoids the collision. Fix with the M1 delta, since the head moves anyway.

N2 (nit) — two bounds on "joins" that neither the row nor `hooks.mdx:373-374` states. (a) A second `ctx.api.transaction` inside the first, in one body, is refused (`quickjs-runner.ts:806-807`). (b) A unit a sandboxed body opened itself is never ambient: the trio does not publish into the store (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:6681-6693`; the one publisher is `engine-transactions-section.ts:177`), and the write door opens none under a threaded handle (`engine-hooks-and-functions.ts:538-539`). So a hook body's `ctx.api.transaction` fired by a write inside an action body's transaction opens a second driver transaction instead of joining, which makes "or a caller's" too wide for that caller. (b) is read in code, not measured. Follow-up card.

N3 (nit) — not stated by the row, each for the follow-up card: the ledger carve-out (a lifecycle-classed ledger on another datasource is written outside the transaction, not refused); on PostgreSQL a throw that is a failed statement aborts the whole unit even when the body catches it (`hooks.mdx:347-354`), so "a throw the body catches keeps the callback's writes" holds for a throw the body raises itself; and the silent degrade on a driver with no transactions, which the old row did not state either.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`

Cases 28 and 29 test what the text teaches (① item 9). Case 29 exercises the M1 line without asserting on it; when M1 is fixed, a `must_not_contain` of `ctx.input.id` would pin it, as case 12 does for its own. Findings: N1, and S1's wording in case 28.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file)

Agrees with the contract it enforces (① item 10): the ceiling equals the measured count, the comment's arithmetic matches the diff, and the raise path is the one the header recognises. It must move again with the M1, S1 and S2 fixes, by measurement.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `84b73e214610ea6179b01f0411b3488806aef1dd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Delta review of PR #35309. Round 1 is record 6999973886 on head `f7fa38653f`; it stands for everything this record does not name. Read here: the one commit since that head (`84b73e2146`, 4 files, +33 −31), the cited code at the new head, the updated PR body, card #35324, and the check-runs on the new head. `data-hooks.md:N` is the new head's file.

`Security-touching` stays `yes` for the round-1 reason: the PR still shortens three passages that teach permission and sharing behaviour. The delta adds no security teaching and removes none. No protection bypass was found.

### ① Derived judgments

Each claim of the fix round, judged against the tree:

1. Texts example (`data-hooks.md:870-872`): right. The `afterInsert` body now links by `ctx.result.id`. The stored row, id included, is the after-hook's result (`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts:1617`) and reaches the body as `ctx.result` (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts:1573`, `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:717`). It agrees with the file's own `ctx.result` row (`:249`) and pattern 2 (`:629`).
2. `api.transaction` row (`:328`): right. "One transaction on the default datasource" and "a write in it to an object on any other datasource is refused before it runs" match `packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts:228`, `:315-326` and `packages/objectql/src/engine-execute-transactions.ts:293-320`. The join sentences are unchanged from round 1.
3. Translation key (`:882`): right. The bullet names the key inline, `hooks.{hook}.texts.{key}.message`, in the placeholder form the `refusals` bullet uses (`:855`); it is the key the runtime reads (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:4651-4653`). The pointer to objectstack-i18n now covers the bundle only.
4. "Why so few?" sentence: restored. Lines 42-54 of the note are byte-identical to merge-base `c809deb67b`, and the file no longer differs from `main` there.
5. Four new cuts: each is a true restatement and none removes the only statement of a rule.
   - Body-shape comment ("the FUNCTION BODY only, not a module"), 44 bytes: kept at `:231-233` (the function body the runtime wraps) and `:349` (imports rejected).
   - `ctx.email` row ("not in a hook body"), 20 bytes: kept at `:331`, with the refusal at parse and at bind.
   - `api.read` row (the two `ctx.title` clauses), 87 bytes: kept at `:261` (plain form "no extra read", lookup form "needs `api.read`").
   - `notice?` comment in the `HookContext` listing, 50 bytes: kept at `:259`, which carries the link to Save Notice.
   - No gate or test pins a removed string (the files that name `data-hooks.md` were read: `scripts/check-corpus-claim-drift.mjs`, `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/scoped-context.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/overlap-hook-template.integration.test.ts`).
6. Eval sources: no `must_contain` token lost its source. Over the 48 graded cases (187 tokens), the set of tokens with no literal hit in the bundle is the same 21 on `main`, on the round-1 head, on this head and on this head merged with `main`; against `main` only three tokens changed, all newly present (`ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`, `texts`, `ctx.text`). No case's prompt or expected answer turns on a statement one of the four new cuts removed.
   - Correction to record 6999973886, ① item 8: it said all 187 tokens are present in the bundle. That was wrong. The reading was a base-against-head comparison; 21 of the 187 are compositions of a case's own names (for example `CREDIT_LIMIT: {`) and are in no bundle file on `main` either. The conclusion there is unchanged: no cut removed a token's source.
7. Eval 28: right. The object is `bank_transfer`, named a business object; the expected answer says the default datasource only, that a plain `ctx.api` write inside the save's unit is refused the same way (`engine-execute-transactions.ts:309-319`; `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx:338-340`), and that the write belongs outside the unit, in an `async: true` hook (`hooks.mdx:382-383`). The prompt still leaks neither asserted token.
8. Eval 29: right. The expected answer links by `ctx.result.id`, and `must_not_contain` carries `related_to_lead: ctx.input.id`, which no bundle file contains any longer.
9. Ratchet: the numbers hold. Head file 40486 bytes, `ceil(40486 / 4) = 10122`, equal to the row. Per-hunk deltas against merge-base: ten cuts of 137, 44, 20, 87, 161, 85, 241, 50, 223 and 275 bytes, 1323 in all; three additions of 144, 400 and 1261, 1805 in all; net 482. The row moves +111 over `main`'s 10011, pinned at the measurement, and the row comment says the same. Ruling 6513306068 letter B still permits it: the deletions are same-file restatements shown in the diff, and the PR body quotes the 2026-10-27 words and the record, with each of the ten cuts and its other home listed.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and right: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, both lines in the PR body and the changeset body. The changeset prose was brought in line with the fix (default datasource, the key, ten cuts). `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 findings: M1: closed. S1: closed. S2: closed. N1 was taken in the same commit (① item 7). N2, N3 and out-of-scope note 1 are carried by card #35324 and are accepted on this head.
- Cross-PR: PR #34964's cited home (the "Why so few?" sentence) is intact again, so the hazard flagged in round 1 is gone. None of the four new cuts' homes is touched by #34964.
- Overlap, read with `git merge-tree` on the current heads: this head merges without conflict into `main` (`de8d54975c`) and with #34964, #35312, #35302 and #35300. Eval ids do not collide in the shared file: 28 and 29 here, 25 and 26 in #34964, 30 and 31 in #35312.
- Still true from round 1: the row is pinned at this PR's own byte count. If #34964 lands first, the file changes under it and the pin and its arithmetic comment need re-measuring before this PR enters the queue.
- Check-runs on this head at 2026-11-19T04:58:28Z: none red. 26 success, among them `Type Check · source gates` (which runs the skills token ratchet and `check:skill-links`), `Type Check · consumer gates` (which runs `check:skill-examples`), `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Build Core` and `Test Core (3/10)`. 3 in progress: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Test Core (1/10)` and `Test Core (2/10)`. 18 skipped. This verdict is on the tree; landing still waits for the full set to finish green.
- The PR body's acceptance note still calls note 1 "not filed"; card #35324 now carries it.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: the three fixes hold against the code they cite (① items 1 to 3), the restored sentence is exact, and the four new cuts keep every rule stated (① item 5).

N4 (nit) — two of the new cuts leave a rule stated less directly, and both are accepted as they stand. The `ctx.email` row of the hook `ctx` table now reads only "Gated by `email.send`"; the hook-body ban is in the capability row at `:331`, and the refusal is at parse, so the gap is loud. "Plain `ctx.title()` needs no token" is now carried by "no extra read" at `:261` rather than said outright; the worst outcome is an unneeded `api.read` grant.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: cases 28 and 29 test what the text teaches and their expected answers now agree with the code (① items 7 and 8). The file is valid, 27 cases, ids unique.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file): the ceiling equals the measured count and the comment's arithmetic matches the diff (① item 9).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据技能 `data-hooks.md` 改写钩子事务一行(默认数据源上的一个事务，写其他数据源的对象执行前即被拒),新增 `texts` 声明文字的示例(afterInsert 用 `ctx.result.id`),内联键名 `hooks.HOOK.texts.KEY.message`;评测 28、29 对齐；10 处同文件复述删减。

- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、评测、changeset 与棘轮数字；无代码。回滚 = revert。棘轮 data-hooks 行 10122(较 main +111,按裁决 B)。
